title: Original Oven Dutch Powder Pancakes
description: A traditional Dutch dish featuring a mixture of powder, perfect for a keto-friendly brunch, with a cultured and glassy-jelly texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, granulated sweetener, and baking powder.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, eggs, sour cream, vanilla extract, and salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Let the batter rest for 10 minutes to allow the flour to absorb the liquid.
Pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
